messages:
deploy-bot: deploycheck FAILED for release v2.7.3 -> env-parity: PROD keystore missing key INFERENCE_S3_PREFIX; blocking promotion. (check: keystore+secrets-scope)

morgan: :eyes: which service/helm chart is affected?

deploy-bot: service=inference-cache, chart=infra/cache, env=prod, failing-check=keystore-entry-not-found

alex: I rolled a small helm-values refactor earlier today (PR #482) that changed keystore namespace from `project/` -> `team/`. Could be a scope mismatch during sync.

morgan: looking at staging — it has `inference/s3_prefix: s3://redwood-inference-staging/cache/` in keystore. prod has no `inference/s3_prefix` entry. Did keystore-sync run during the infra deploy window?

emily: I kicked the keystore-sync job ~10m ago but saw failures writing to prod KMS alias. Logs had 403 on PutSecretValue. Suspect an IAM policy change. @ryan can you confirm the prod KMS role?

ryan: oncall — checking now. I can see a policy roll that removed PutSecretValue for service-account:keystore-sync@infra-prod. Rolling that policy back now.

alex: if we can restore permissions quickly we can re-run sync. Otherwise fallback is manual sops put into prod but that's messy during a release window.

morgan: rollout contains the batching change + quant-variant pin; if we backfill manually we risk human error. What's the risk of pausing? Do we have a rollback plan?

emily: pausing keeps prod stable (no config drift). Rollback would revert batching and quant pin — cost spike possible. I prefer pause until keystore is backfilled and then a controlled canary.

morgan: decision: PAUSE rollout. @deploy-bot set release status=paused and block promotion until keystore contains INFERENCE_S3_PREFIX or manual approval. Add note to release log.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. release v2.7.3 status=PAUSED. reason="prod-keystore-missing:INFERENCE_S3_PREFIX". action_required=["keystore-sync", "confirm KMS perms"]

ryan: policy rollback applied. re-triggering keystore-sync job now. I'll paste logs when it finishes.

emily: also preparing a short rollback playbook and a pin PR (pin image tag -> v2.7.2) so we can hot-swap if needed. Alex can you open the PR?

alex: on it — PR #491 created to pin image + add a short entry in release-notes: "pause-resources: handled keystore parity incident".

morgan: thanks. prefer not to hot-swap unless absolutely necessary. waiting for keystore-sync result. if no success in 15m we proceed with pin/hotfix.

[~1m later]

deploy-bot: keystore-sync job started: job/keystore-sync-2023-11-01. command: `kubectl logs job/keystore-sync-2023-11-01 -n infra`

[~4m later]

ryan: keystore-sync completed: wrote key `inference/s3_prefix` -> `s3://redwood-inference-prod/cache/` (HTTP 200). snippet from logs:

```
I1101 12:34:21 keystore-sync.go:142] Writing key inference/s3_prefix to prod keystore
I1101 12:34:22 keystore-sync.go:178] PutSecretValue succeeded for inference/s3_prefix (alias: projects/prod/kms/alias/keystore)
```

emily: great. recommend resuming with a small canary first (10%) and watch cache hit-rate and manifest errors.

morgan: agree. @deploy-bot resume release with canary=10% and add a check to watch for `cache-miss-rate` > 5% in first 5m.

deploy-bot: release v2.7.3 RESUMED (canary=10%). watchers=[morgan, alex, emily, ryan]. added healthwatch: metrics(cache-miss-rate > 5% -> alert). logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/v2.7.3/canary

emily: I'll watch logs and metrics. if anything unusual we abort and pin to v2.7.2.

alex: PR #491 merged (pin v2.7.2) as standby; not deployed.

morgan: monitoring for 10m. thanks all. :thumbsup:

[~12m later]

deploy-bot: canary passed checks (10m window). promoting remainder of rollout. release v2.7.3 -> SUCCESSFUL. note: incident noted in release-log: "keystore parity caused pause; root cause: IAM policy roll affecting keystore-sync; mitigation: policy rollback + keystore-sync; follow-up: add automated IAM regression guard and add keystore key presence check to deploycheck."

emily: filing a post-incident action item to add keystore presence check + automation to fail fast at predeploy.

morgan: filing an RFC to prevent manual IAM changes in prod during release windows. link when ready.

ryan: oncall cleared. closing thread.
